offline_tests.scope: Pinned file inputs, identity/quota/time failures, lock and durable marker before sole submit, restart refusal, ambiguous response handling, bounded read-only collection

result_interpretation: Exit 0 after terminal status means log collection succeeded, not that the official evaluation is valid. Inspect saved remote status and official log; no automatic main promotion.
resume_rule: Never remove submit-attempt.json to retry an ambiguous outcome. First inspect authoritative official status and any still-running docker process.
